articles.summary: The new 9016-BT High Dump Cart from Art’s Way was specifically designed to boost efficiency during the beet harvest. The 9016-BT wheel base is set so the tires can run through the field without damaging unlifted beets. The 15-inch wide tires, centered on 132 inches, straddle six rows of beets.
